title: Four Corners
prompt:
The HTML has four paragraphs with ids upleft, upright, downleft, and downright. Pin each one to the matching corner of the preview and give each a colored border. Use position: fixed so they stick to the preview viewport.

  • #upleft — pin to the upper left with top: 0 and left: 0, and a 2px solid red border
  • #upright — pin to the upper right with a 2px solid green border
  • #downleft — pin to the lower left with a 2px solid orange border
  • #downright — pin to the lower right with a 2px solid blue border

After you Run, you should see one bordered label in each corner of the preview.

html.starter:
up left

up right

down left

down right

css.starter: /* Pin each paragraph to a corner and add a colored border */

tests.name: CSS validates
tests.feedback: Fix the CSS validation errors shown in the test details.

tests.name: #upleft top-left with red border
tests.feedback: Set #upleft to position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; border: 2px solid red;

tests.name: #upright top-right with green border
tests.feedback: Pin #upright to the upper-right corner with position: fixed and a 2px solid green border.

tests.name: #downleft bottom-left with orange border
tests.feedback: Pin #downleft to the lower-left corner with position: fixed and a 2px solid orange border.

tests.name: #downright bottom-right with blue border
tests.feedback: Pin #downright to the lower-right corner with position: fixed and a 2px solid blue border.
